How to build strong companies
  1. Recruit companies in the Recruit tab.
  2. Earn stars with Drill companies in the same tab (gold 70, food 30, 2 days). Each star gives attack +8% and damage taken -6%. Twice at most.
  3. Companies with two stars and 90 or more men can be made elite below (gold
